citation: Allen Institute for Brain Science, Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework version 3 (CCFv3), 2017 annotation, 25 µm; structure graph 1 snapshot. Wang Q et al. The Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework: A 3D Reference Atlas. Cell 181, 936–953.e20 (2020), doi:10.1016/j.cell.2020.04.007.

derivation.cortex_selection: Source-present Isocortex anatomy nodes whose official name does not contain the word 'layer' (case insensitive, including /Layer names); explicit frozen-tree layer exceptions 810/819 (ACAv6a/ACAv6b, whose names omit 'layer') are also excluded and map to their official parent 48 (ACAv). Layer IDs map by actual official ancestry, never acronym guessing. Catalog retains the complete frozen tree, including nodes with no labels/descendant labels in the 2017 annotation.

non_layer_named_cortical_leaf_audit.scope: All leaf nodes below Isocortex 315 in the frozen official tree whose English name does not contain the word 'layer'.
non_layer_named_cortical_leaf_audit.finding: 810/819 are ACAv layers 6a/6b; 738 is Orbital area, ventral part (ORBv), an anatomical region. No other non-layer-named cortical leaves exist in this frozen tree. All 62 non-layer-named cortical nodes were additionally inspected; no further cellular-layer exception found.

derivation.partition: Overview only: each label maps to its deepest selected official ancestor. Selected parents receive only labels not assigned to a selected descendant. Regions are disjoint; ancestor selection highlights descendant shapes instead of painting a parent union over children.
derivation.dorsal_projection: For each AP/LR pixel, scan SI from 0 (dorsal) upwards; take the first label in Isocortex or its descendants, then apply the same navigation partition. No cortex at that column remains background. Non-cortical labels before cortex are skipped, rather than displayed or assigned cortex.
derivation.coronal_slices: All 528 fixed AP indices 0..527, without resampling or label merging. Each nonzero source label has its own official-color polygon. Empty AP sections are explicitly recorded in coverage. Geometry is loaded one section at a time from independently hashed release resources.
derivation.preferred_slice: Maximum coronal voxel count of the region plus all descendants, with the lowest AP index winning a tie. Null only when neither self nor descendants have labels.
derivation.geometry: Directed voxel-edge tracing; only collinear vertices removed; disconnected islands and holes retained; no smoothing or anatomical invention.
derivation.colors: Official frozen graph color_hex_triplet, identical region ID/color in both views. Function descriptions are separately curated literature annotations.

limitations: Dorsal first-isocortex projection omits cortex not visible along this direction; it is not a flattened/unfolded cortical surface or official Allen flatmap.
Overview colors aggregate cortical layers; all coronal nonzero labels retain their original identity.
A structure absent from this 25 µm label volume is still searchable in the complete tree; a parent with labeled descendants navigates to their maximum-area section.
25 µm voxel edges are not individual brain anatomy, stimulation fields, stereotaxic targeting or cross-atlas registration.
Structure graph 1 endpoint can evolve: this exact source hash is frozen; all names and relationships are those of the cached snapshot.
